sloka: उपाव्Rत्य उत्थिताम् दीनाम् वडवाम् इव वाहिताम् ।पाम्शु गुण्ठित सर्व अग्नीम् विममर्श च पाणिना ॥२-२०-३४॥
transliteration: upāvRtya utthitām dīnām vaḍavām iva vāhitām ।pāmśu guṇṭhita sarva agnīm vimamarśa ca pāṇinā ॥2-20-34॥

translations.english: Rama gently wiped away the dust that had covered her body as Kausalya stood miserable, like a mare who stands up after having rolled on the ground while pulling the load.
